contexts.text: In each of his ideas there is an image of himself, which... is so ugly as to be a horror.
(The unregenerate form of the spirit) is that of hatred and cruelty, and is of inexpressible ugliness.
The spirit of him whose external man is opposite to his internal man... is black and ugly, such as is the love of self and of the world...
The infernals, being against good and truth, have horrible ugliness (or deformity). AC 5377:end. AC 5387:end, Explained. AC 5717. Described.
If the communication (of a Spirit) is with, infernal Societies, his form is ugly and diabolical.
When evil of life inflows into the understanding, it produces deformed ideas...
When such come into a more interior Heaven, they become ugly from the falsities which are from the evils with them.
In some who had beautiful faces, the spirit was seen to be ugly, black, and monstrous.
If a man is evil, his spirit, when viewed by the Angels, appears as a monster, ugly according to his evil.
(Former acquaintances) who had been in evil affections, I did not recognize (on account of their) ugly faces.
They who are corporeal loves appear gross, dusky, black, and ugly.
As the eye looking at a beautiful object sees it accurately while something ugly is beside it; and therefore it is usual for painters to set an ugly face beside a beautiful one.
The faces of the evil of this Earth in the other life become successively so ugly and distorted that they cannot be looked at by the Spirits of Jupiter on account of their ugliness.
Thus they become effigies of death, so ugly that the ugliness cannot be described.
As the (antediluvian) men grew up, they became ugly, hairy.
The faces of the evil, when seen in the light of Heaven, appear monstrous, of various ugliness, Explained.
In place of the beauty possessed by those who live chastely in marriages, there is the ugliness of those who live in adulteries...
